findings.fix: Remove this paragraph from the form entirely; display it only after successful form submission.
findings.location: Inside `<div id="row-phone">`, after the phone input
findings.violation: A success message appears in the middle of an active form, confusing users about whether signup is complete before they finish filling it out.

findings.fix: Add `name="preferred_shipping_speed"` (or similar) to the select element.
findings.violation: Without a name attribute, the selected shipping speed won't be submitted with the form data.

findings.fix: Add value attributes to each option: `<option value="standard">Standard</option>`, etc.
findings.violation: Options lack explicit value attributes, relying on text content as values, which is fragile and unclear.

findings.evidence: Full name input with `name="full_name"` followed later by separate First name `name="given_name"` and Last name `name="family_name"` fields
findings.fix: Remove either the "Full name" field or the "First name"/"Last name" field pair; keep only one approach.
findings.violation: The form asks for the user's name twice in different formats, creating confusion and redundant data collection.

findings.evidence: No validation pattern despite placeholder stating "Must be 8 digits"
findings.fix: Add `pattern="[0-9]{8}"` to enforce validation of exactly 8 digits.
findings.location: `<input id="member-input" name="membership_number" type="text" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="Must be 8 digits">`
findings.violation: The membership number field accepts any text despite requiring exactly 8 digits; the placeholder alone doesn't enforce the requirement.

findings.fix: Change to `type="time"` for proper time input with browser-native controls.
findings.violation: Using text input for time data makes it easy to enter invalid values and doesn't provide user-friendly time selection.

findings.fix: Increase font-size to at least 14px and padding to at least 8px 12px, or use a standard button style class.
